title: Calibration-Guided Thermal-Anomaly Detection for Reliable UAV Infrared Inspection of Photovoltaic Plants — Code & Annotation Archive
description: Companion code and annotation archive for the TIMC manuscript: statistical thermal-anomaly proposal generator, operating-point calibration records (F2 plateau-centre selection), seed-42 splits, 197 calibration boxes, 350-image frozen test ground truth, 50-image human inter-annotator agreement sample (box-F1 0.823), matched-budget teacher-student baselines (0.938 / 0.932), and uncertainty/statistics scripts. Imagery not redistributed (PVF-10, public).
